t:
Find the median of the following data. (Rounded off to 2 decimal places.)
Class interval | 0-5 | 5-10 | 10-15 | 15-20 | 20-25 | 25-30 | 30-35
Frequency | 3 | 5 | 4 | 2 | 7 | 6 | 5
e:
Total frequency (n): 3 + 5 + 4 + 2 + 7 + 6 + 5 = 32
Median position: (n/2) = 16th term
Cumulative frequencies:
0-5: 3
5-10: 8
10-15: 12
15-20: 14
20-25: 21
25-30: 27
30-35: 32
Median class: 20-25 (since 14 < 16 ≤ 21)
L = 20, F = 14, f = 7, c = 5
Median = L + ((n/2 - F) / f) X c
L- Lower limit of median class
F- Cummulative frequency
f- Freaquency of median class
c- class width
n- Total frequency.
= 20 + ((16 - 14) / 7) X 5
= 20 + (2/7) X 5
= 20 + 10/7 = 20 + 1.42857 = 21.42857
= 21.43
Option (a) is the correct answer.

e:
To find the median, we need to arrange the weights in ascending order and identify the middle value since there are 7 numbers (an odd count).
Given weights: 54, 62, 65, 70, 60, 59, 55.
ascending order: 54, 55, 59, 60, 62, 65, 70.
Since there are 7 numbers,
So the median is: (n+1/2)<sup>th</sup> number
(7+1/2)<sup>th</sup> = 4<sup>th</sup> number = 60

t: The marks obtained by 15 students out of a maximum of 25 in a test are given as 13, 11, 16, 15, 18, 12, 13, 14, 10, 22, 15, 21, 20, 17 and 24. Find the product of the modes of this set of data.

So, median (X) = 55
New data after replacing 50 with 80 = 39, 40, 51, 55, 68, 71, 72, 79, and 80

t: If the difference of the mode and median of a date is 41, then the difference of the median and mean is?
e:
Given that,
Mode - Median = 41
Mode = 41 + Median
We know that,
Mode = 3 x Median - 2 x Mean
41 + Median = 3 x Median - 2 x Mean
41 = 2 x Median - 2 x Mean
Median - Mean = 41/2 = 20.5
h: यदि किसी तिथि के बहुलक और माध्यिका का अंतर 41 है, तो माध्यिका और माध्यिका का अंतर क्या है?

t: If the standard deviation of a given data is 0.52, then find the variance of that data.
e:
We know that standard deviation of observations is equal to square root of variance of those observations.
Given,
0.52 = √Variance
Variance = 0.52 * 0.52 = 0.2704
h: यदि किसी दिए गए डेटा का मानक विचलन 0.52 है, तो उस डेटा का प्रसरण ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The mean of 13 observations is 50 and the median of the observations is 47. Find the mode of the observations.
e:
Mean of 13 observations = 50
Median of 13 observations = 47
Since, we know that-
Mode = 3*median - 2*mean
= 3*47 - 2*50
= 141 - 100
= 41

The distribution of 100 workmen employed in a factory according to their monthly salary, showed an average salary of ₹4,500 per month. If the median salary is found to be ₹4,900, find the mode salary.
e:
Mean salary = ₹4500, Median salary = ₹4900
Now,
Mode = 3 * Median - 2 * Mean
Mode = 3 * 4900 - 2 * 4500
= 14700 - 9000
= ₹5700
